hook.name: EpochHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for Epochpad coins (ETH/coin pools, 0 LP fee) that charges a composite fee (base + trade-size + MEV priority-fee + anti-snipe components) collected as ERC-6909 claims via swap deltas. After each sell, triggers a support action from banked claims: price-band buyback, buy-and-burn, or permanent full-range liquidity addition.
